items.source: Such service locators permit the decoupling of calling code from the BeanFactory API, by using an appropriate custom locator interface. They will typically be used for prototype beans, i.e. for factory methods that are supposed to return a new instance for each call. The client receives a reference to the service locator via setter or constructor injection, to be able to invoke the locator's factory methods on demand. For singleton beans, direct setter or constructor injection of the target bean is preferable.
items.translation: 此类服务定位器通过使用适当的自定义定位器接口，实现了调用代码与BeanFactory API 的解耦。它们通常用于原型 Bean，即那些旨在为每次调用返回新实例的工厂方法。客户端通过 setter 或构造函数注入接收服务定位器的引用，以便按需调用定位器的工厂方法。对于单例 Bean，直接进行目标 Bean 的 setter 或构造函数注入更可取。

items.source: On invocation of the no-arg factory method, or the single-arg factory method with a String id of null or empty String, if exactly one bean in the factory matches the return type of the factory method, that bean is returned, otherwise a NoSuchBeanDefinitionException is thrown.
items.translation: 在调用无参工厂方法，或带有 `null` 或空 String id 的单参工厂方法时，如果工厂中恰好有一个bean 与工厂方法的返回类型匹配，则返回该 bean；否则抛出NoSuchBeanDefinitionException。

items.source: The default implementation looks for a constructor with one of the following parameter types: (String, Throwable) or (Throwable) or (String).
items.translation: 默认实现会查找具有以下参数类型之一的构造函数：(String, Throwable) 或 (Throwable) 或 (String)。

items.source: On invocation of the single-arg factory method with a non-null (and non-empty) argument, the proxy returns the result of a BeanFactory.getBean(String) call, using a stringified version of the passed-in id as bean name.
items.translation: 在调用带有非空（且非空）参数的单参数工厂方法时，代理会返回 `BeanFactory.getBean(String)` 调用的结果，使用传入 id 的字符串版本作为 bean 名称。

items.source: A factory method argument will usually be a String, but can also be an int or a custom enumeration type, for example, stringified via toString. The resulting String can be used as bean name as-is, provided that corresponding beans are defined in the bean factory. Alternatively, a custom mapping between service IDs and bean names can be defined.
items.translation: 工厂方法参数通常为 String，但也可能是 int 或自定义枚举类型（例如通过 `toString` 转换为字符串）。生成的 String 可以直接用作 Bean 名称，前提是 Bean 工厂中已定义了相应的 Bean。或者，可以定义服务 ID 与 Bean 名称之间的自定义映射。

items.source:
If not specified, subclasses of Spring's BeansException will be thrown,
for example NoSuchBeanDefinitionException. As those are unchecked, the
caller does not need to handle them, so it might be acceptable that
Spring exceptions get thrown as long as they are just handled generically.
items.translation: 如果未指定，将抛出 Spring 的 BeansException 的子类，例如 NoSuchBeanDefinitionException。由于这些是 unchecked（非检查）异常，调用者无需处理它们，因此只要 Spring 异常被泛化处理，其抛出也是可以接受的。

items.source:
The default implementation can handle all variations of

items.translation: 默认实现可以处理所有消息和异常参数的变体。

items.source: Set the service locator interface to use, which must have one or more methods with the signatures MyType xxx() or MyType xxx(MyIdType id) (typically, MyService getService() or MyService getService(String id)). See the class-level Javadoc for information on the semantics of such methods.
items.translation: 设置要使用的服务定位器接口，该接口必须包含一个或多个签名为 `MyType xxx()` 或 `MyType xxx(MyIdType id)` 的方法（通常为 `MyService getService()` 或 `MyService getService(String id)`）。有关此类方法的语义信息，请参阅 类级别 Javadoc。

items.source: NOTE: This method returning false does not necessarily indicate that returned objects are independent instances. An implementation of the extended SmartFactoryBean interface may explicitly indicate independent instances through its SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() method. Plain FactoryBean implementations which do not implement this extended interface are simply assumed to always return independent instances if the isSingleton() implementation returns false.
items.translation: 注意：此方法返回 false 并不一定表示返回的对象是独立实例。实现扩展的SmartFactoryBean接口的实现可以通过其 SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() 方法明确指示独立实例。未实现此扩展接口的普通 FactoryBean 实现，如果其isSingleton() 实现返回 false，则假定总是返回独立实例。

items.source: FactoryBeans are allowed to return null objects. The bean factory will consider this as a normal value to be used and will not throw a FactoryBeanNotInitializedException in this case. However, FactoryBean implementations are encouraged to throw FactoryBeanNotInitializedException themselves, as appropriate.
items.translation: FactoryBeans 允许返回 `null` 对象。在此情况下，Bean 工厂会将其视为正常值并使用该值，而不会抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。不过，建议 FactoryBean 实现类根据具体情况自行抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。

items.source: NOTE: If a FactoryBean indicates that it holds a singleton object, the object returned from getObject() might get cached by the owning BeanFactory. Hence, do not return true unless the FactoryBean always exposes the same reference.
items.translation: 注意：如果 FactoryBean 表明它持有一个单例对象，那么从 getObject() 返回的对象可能会被其拥有的 BeanFactory 缓存。因此，除非 FactoryBean 始终暴露相同的引用，否则不要返回 true。

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后，但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

items.source: As with a BeanFactory, this allows support for both the Singleton and Prototype design patterns.
items.translation: 与BeanFactory一样，它支持单例和原型这两种设计模式。

items.source: If this FactoryBean is not fully initialized yet at the time of the call (for example because it is involved in a circular reference), throw a corresponding FactoryBeanNotInitializedException.
items.translation: 如果在此调用时该 FactoryBean 尚未完全初始化（例如因为它涉及循环引用），则抛出相应的FactoryBeanNotInitializedException。

items.source: NOTE: Autowiring will simply ignore FactoryBeans that return null here. Therefore, it is highly recommended to implement this method properly, using the current state of the FactoryBean.
items.translation: 注意： 自动装配将简单地忽略在此处返回`null`的 FactoryBean。因此，强烈建议使用 FactoryBean 的当前状态正确实现此方法。

items.source: The default implementation returns true, since a FactoryBean typically manages a singleton instance.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 true，因为 FactoryBean 通常管理一个单例实例。

items.source: This method can be called before this FactoryBean has been fully initialized. It must not rely on state created during initialization; of course, it can still use such state if available.
items.translation: 此方法可以在该 FactoryBean 完全初始化之前被调用。它不能依赖在初始化期间创建的状态；当然，如果可用，它仍然可以使用此类状态。

items.source:

configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source:
This allows one to check for specific types of beans without
instantiating objects, for example on autowiring.
items.translation: 这允许在例如自动装配时，无需实例化对象即可检查特定类型的 Bean。

items.source:
In the case of implementations that create a singleton object,
this method should try to avoid singleton creation as far as possible;
it should rather estimate the type in advance.
For prototypes, returning a meaningful type here is advisable too.
items.translation: 对于创建单例对象的实现，此方法应尽可能避免创建单例；相反，它应预先估算类型。对于原型对象，在此处返回有意义的类型也是可取的。

items.source:

be provided by the owning BeanFactory; usually, it has to be

items.translation: FactoryBean 本身的单例状态通常由拥有它的 BeanFactory 提供；通常，它必须在那里被定义为单例。
